user.title: Sigen cloud login
user.description: Log in with the email and password you use for the Sigen app. Leave Station ID empty to use your main station; to add another station on the same account, enter its ID (shown in the Sigen app's station settings) and add the integration once per station.

data_description.region: The Sigen cloud your account is on (the server you pick in the Sigen app). Only Europe has been tested; promos may not be available in other regions.

reauth_confirm.title: Sigen login expired
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the Sigen app password for {username}.

reconfigure.title: Change Sigen login
reconfigure.description: Update the region, email and password used for the Sigen cloud. The login must belong to the same station.

error.invalid_station: That station ID wasn't found on this account.
error.wrong_station: That login can't access this station.

abort.already_configured: This Sigen station is already set up.
abort.wrong_station: That login belongs to a different Sigen station. To switch station, delete this entry and add the integration again.

add_promo.name: Add promo
add_promo.description: Set a promotional buy and/or sell price for a time window. Windows past midnight are split into one promo per day. Adding a promo that already exists does nothing. If the Sigen cloud can't be reached, the save is retried for about 1.5 minutes before failing.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the promo starts (local time). For a repeating promo, the first day and the daily start time.

end.name: End
end.description: When it ends. For a repeating promo, the same day as start (a repeating promo can't cross midnight).

buy.name: Buy price
buy.description: Import price during the promo, per kWh in the station's main currency unit (0.15, not 15). Leave out to keep the normal import price.

sell.name: Sell price
sell.description: Export price during the promo, per kWh in the station's main currency unit (0.15, not 15). Leave out to keep the normal export price.

label.name: Label
label.description: Name shown for this promo in Home Assistant, e.g. 'Axle event'. Stored in Home Assistant only; the Sigen app doesn't show it.

replace_label.name: Replace same label
replace_label.description: Remove promos with the same label that haven't started yet, so the label always means one window (e.g. the next Axle event moved or changed).

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Once, every day, or on chosen weekdays.

until.name: Until
until.description: Last day of a repeating promo. Required when repeating.

on_overlap.name: If it overlaps
on_overlap.description: What to do if an existing promo overlaps this one.

config_entry_id.name: Station
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one Sigen station.

sync_promos.name: Sync promos
sync_promos.description: Make one label's upcoming promos match a list of time windows, for example every session in a calendar. Missing windows are added, windows no longer listed are removed (promos already running are kept), and nothing is saved if they already match.

label.name: Label
label.description: The promos this action manages. Promos with other labels, or none, are left alone.

windows.name: Windows
windows.description: List of windows, each with start and end, e.g. the events from calendar.get_events. Extra fields are ignored.

buy.name: Buy price
buy.description: Import price during each window, per kWh in the station's main currency unit (0.15, not 15). Leave out to keep the normal import price.

sell.name: Sell price
sell.description: Export price during each window, per kWh in the station's main currency unit (0.15, not 15). Leave out to keep the normal export price.

on_overlap.name: If it overlaps
on_overlap.description: What to do if another promo overlaps a window. Defaults to replace.

config_entry_id.name: Station
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one Sigen station.

remove_promo.name: Remove promo
remove_promo.description: Remove promos by label, by time window, or both. Promos that have already started are kept unless 'include started' is on.

start.name: Start
start.description: Remove promos overlapping this window (give end too).

include_started.name: Include started
include_started.description: Also remove promos that are running or have already started.

config_entry_id.name: Station
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one Sigen station.

clear_promos.name: Clear promos
clear_promos.description: Remove every promo on the station.

config_entry_id.name: Station
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one Sigen station.

list_promos.name: List promos
list_promos.description: Return every current and upcoming promo.

config_entry_id.name: Station
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with more than one Sigen station.

init.title: Sigen promotional tariffs
init.description: How often to re-read promos from the Sigen cloud. Changes made by this integration show up straight away; this only affects promos changed elsewhere, such as in the Sigen app.

save_failed.title: Sigen promo not saved ({station})
